## Activity

During May 2025, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 453 captures. This report summarises activity recorded during the month and provides the associated image-quality and grading results. The capture total represents the submissions completed by the clinic team for review within the reporting period. Activity remained focused on completing and forwarding images for assessment through the established service process.

## Image quality

Of the 453 captures, 22 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.9. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that proceeded to assessment. The result provides a measure of image usability for the month and should be considered alongside the overall capture activity.

## Grading

A total of 136 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2. This records the midpoint waiting time for grading during May 2025. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. Together, these results provide the monthly position for West Gate Eye Clinic across activity, image quality and grading.
